stops.why_hr: Start on the square: the well that gave the city its name
The funicular, the shortest public railway in the world
Lotrščak tower and the cannon that marks noon
The Stone Gate, the only gate of Gradec left standing
St Mark's square: the free royal town and its charter
The tunnel dug under Gradec in the war
Dolac, the market above the old walls
The cathedral, and the earthquake that rebuilt it
Kaptol, where the diocese and the name begin
End at the theatre on the Green Horseshoe
